svg.text: GRADED DUST BOUNDARY · ZONE SECTION · TRAVELLING-WAVE DETAIL · VOLUME III · SHEET 1 OF 5

g.text: SECTION — DIRTIEST AT LEFT, CLEANEST AT RIGHT. NOTHING TRAVELS BACKWARDS.
CLEAN — AND STAYING THAT WAY IS A BUDGET
DIRECTIONAL AIRFLOW, DRAINAGE AND SLOPE ALL RUN OUTWARD — DUST GOES HOME, NOT DEEPER
FIG. B — EVERY MECHANISM HAS A DIFFERENT BLIND SPOT
needs gas — none on the Moon
THE RESIDUE OF ONE IS THE TARGET OF THE NEXT.
STACKED, IT IS STILL ASYMPTOTIC — NEVER ZERO.
GRAINS CHARGE, LIFT, AND MARCH OFF
! THE BEST GATE IS THE ONE NOBODY WALKS THROUGH
A SUIT THAT DOCKS TO THE OUTSIDE OF THE HULL AND IS ENTERED
FROM WITHIN NEVER BRINGS ITS DUSTY EXTERIOR INDOORS AT ALL.
THAT REMOVES THE LARGEST SINGLE SOURCE BY REFUSING TO HAVE IT.
THE GATE STILL SERVES CARGO, ROVERS, AND CONTINGENCIES.
! IT IS A BUDGET, NOT A BARRIER
SOME DUST GETS THROUGH EVERY SINGLE CYCLE.
THE DEFENCE IS THAT INGRESS STAYS BELOW INTERNAL REMOVAL.
CYCLE TIME IS THE COST THAT BITES FIRST — A SLOW GATE
QUIETLY REDUCES HOW MUCH WORK GETS DONE OUTSIDE.
